IHeatCapacitor stores both heat and capacity as one state. setHeatAndCapacity uses a subtransaction, setting capacity then heat and commits both before contents listener. getHeat lazily initializes unset -1 to heatCapacity*ambient; explicit restored0 remains0. Cached ambient lookup is a runtime world/position cache, not restored paid heat. Conduction coefficients remain current tier suppliers, while disk capacity overwrites constructor tier capacity.
